# StoryJumper

> > StoryJumper is the #1 rated platform for creating, narrating, and publishing custom storybooks in both digital and physical formats.

StoryJumper empowers students, educators, and authors to create multimedia storybooks with collaborative tools, supporting both educational writing projects and self-publishing of hardcover and paperback books.

## Key Topics

- Storybook creation
- Self-publishing
- Multimedia books
- Educational writing
- Collaborative authoring
- Custom hardcover books
- Student publishing
- Digital storytelling
- Publishing platform
- Educational tool
- Collaborative writing

## Main Platform

- [StoryJumper: #1 rated site for creating story books](https://www.storyjumper.com/): StoryJumper homepage: create, narrate & publish hardcover/paperback books

## Optional

- [StoryJumper: #1 rated site for creating story books](https://test.storyjumper.com/): StoryJumper test environment for development and staging purposes
